items.title: UK school estate hit by 3AM ransomware in suspected AI-assisted attack
items.summary: A 3AM ransomware affiliate targeted a school estate in the UK and successfully encrypted around 37 of nearly 50 machines reached from an unmanaged host. [...]

items.summary_zh: 一名 3AM 勒索軟體加盟者針對英國某學校地產發動攻擊，並成功加密了從一部未受管理的主機所存取之近 50 台機器中的約 37 台。[...]

items.title: Critical Node-RED Flaw Exploited in Attacks
items.summary: Multiple attacks from the same IP address attempted to deploy various payloads, including a Linux bot and webshells. The post Critical Node-RED Flaw Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Critical Node-RED 嚴重漏洞在攻擊中遭利用
items.summary_zh: 來自同一 IP 地址的多起攻擊企圖部署各種載荷，包括 Linux 機器人程式與 Web Shell。本文章《Critical Node-RED Flaw Exploited in Attacks》首次發表於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Barracuda warns of critical flaws allowing root access to devices
items.summary: Cybersecurity company Barracuda Networks warned customers to patch two vulnerabilities that can let attackers run commands with root privileges. [...]
items.title_zh: Barracuda 警告允許取得裝置 Root 權限的嚴重漏洞

items.title: WorkOS says attacker used ARTEX AI to breach internal sales app
items.summary: Developer platform WorkOS suffered a data breach after a threat actor accessed business contact records and summaries of customer communications. [...]
items.title_zh: WorkOS 表示攻擊者利用 ARTEX AI 入侵內部銷售應用程式
items.summary_zh: 開發者平台 WorkOS 在威脅誘因者存取了商業聯絡記錄和客戶通訊摘要後遭遇資料外洩。[...]

items.title: Frontline Education Data Breach Impacts Over 1.3 Million
items.summary: Hackers exploited a flaw in third-party software and stole the personal information of school district staff and students. The post Frontline Education Data Breach Impacts Over 1.3 Million appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Frontline Education 資料外洩事件影響超過 130 萬人
items.summary_zh: 駭客利用第三方軟體中的漏洞，竊取了學區教職員工和學生的個人資訊。這篇 Frontline Education 資料外洩事件影響超過 130 萬人的文章首次出現在 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Harvard University data breach exposed info of 851,000 accounts
items.summary: Hackers who breached Harvard University's Alumni Affairs and Development systems in November 2025 stole data linked to more than 850,000 unique email addresses, according to breach notification service Have I Been Pwned. [...]
items.title_zh: 哈佛大學資料外洩事件暴露 85.1 萬個帳戶資訊
items.summary_zh: 根據外洩通知服務 Have I Been Pwned 的資訊，於 2025 年 11 月入侵哈佛大學校友事務與發展系統的駭客，竊取了與 850,000 多個不重複電子郵件地址相關的資料。[...]

items.title: Your Mobile Carrier Stores Your Call Logs for Years
items.summary: Mobile carriers can retain years of call and text metadata, exposing sensitive details about customers' relationships, locations, and daily routines if breached. Cape examines the privacy risks of long-term telecom data retention and how its mobile service reduces exposure by automatically deleting call records. [...]
items.title_zh: 您的行動電信業者保存您多年的通話紀錄
items.summary_zh: 行動電信業者可能會保留多年的通話與簡訊元資料（metadata），若遭遇外洩，將揭露客戶的社交關係、位置和日常作息等敏感細節。Cape 探討了電信數據長期保留的隱私風險，以及其行動服務如何透過自動刪除通話紀錄來降低暴露風險。[...]

items.title: Florida Student Aid Website Hack Puts Data of 4.9 Million People at Risk
items.summary: The Florida Department of Education says SSNs and other personal data may have been exposed in a breach of its financial aid website. The post Florida Student Aid Website Hack Puts Data of 4.9 Million People at Risk appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: 佛羅里達州學生資助網站遭駭，490 萬人資料面臨風險
items.summary_zh: 佛羅里達州教育局表示，其財務資助網站遭外洩，社會安全碼（SSN）和其他個人資料可能已暴露。該篇文章《佛羅里達州學生資助網站遭駭，490 萬人資料面臨風險》首次發表於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Google: LLMjacking attacks rack up $1 million in cloud AI charges
items.summary: Large language model hijacking attacks, also known as LLMjacking, are generating large fraudulent cloud charges, with some organizations losing more than $100,000 per day. [...]
items.title_zh: Google：LLMjacking 攻擊累積產生高達 100 萬美元的雲端 AI 費用
items.summary_zh: 大型語言模型劫持攻擊（又稱 LLMjacking）正在產生巨額的詐欺性雲端費用，部分組織每天損失超過 100,000 美元。[...]

items.title: Hackers hijack cPGuard autoupdate to deploy backdoor, steal data
items.summary: Attackers have compromised the update infrastructure for the cPGuard web security suite to distribute a backdoor and a data-stealing script. [...]
items.title_zh: 駭客劫持 cPGuard 自動更新以部署後門並竊取資料
items.summary_zh: 攻擊者已入侵 cPGuard 網路安全套件的更新基礎設施，以散佈後門和資料竊取指令碼。[...]

items.title: Binance says fake job interview led to $6.3 billion crypto heist
items.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance says North Korean hackers used a fake job interview to trick an employee into installing malware that ultimately let them compromise the company's wallet infrastructure and steal about $6.34 billion in digital assets. [...]
items.title_zh: 幣安表示假求職面試導致 63 億美元加密貨幣搶案
items.summary_zh: 加密貨幣交易所幣安（Binance）表示，北韓駭客利用假求職面試誘騙一名員工安裝惡意軟體，最終使其入侵公司的錢包基礎設施，並竊取約 63.4 億美元的數位資產。[...]

items.title: Chinese hackers use ARTEX AI in automated attacks against 200 orgs
items.summary: Chinese hackers used ARTEX, an open-source, multi-agent AI penetration-testing framework, in attacks against more than 200 organizations across 14 countries. [...]
items.title_zh: 中國駭客在針對 200 個組織的自動化攻擊中使用 ARTEX AI
items.summary_zh: 中國駭客在針對 14 個國家/地區、超過 200 個組織的攻擊中，使用了開源多代理人 AI 滲透測試框架 ARTEX。[...]
